## Data Extraction

```{r main_libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(obrasgovr) # constuctions API

library(mapview)
```

First we retrieve all projects.

```{r}
#| eval: false

projects <- get_projects(
  all_pages = T,
  page_size = 200
)
```

Then we transform the nested tables into columns.

```{r}
taxonomy_tbl <- projects |>
  select(id_projeto_investimento, eixos_tipos) |>
  unnest_longer(eixos_tipos, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  unnest_wider(eixos_tipos)

pred_investment_tbl <- projects |>
  select(id_projeto_investimento, investimentos_previstos) |>
  unnest_longer(investimentos_previstos, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  unnest_wider(investimentos_previstos) |> 
  group_by(id_projeto_investimento) |>
  summarise(vl_investimento_previsto_total = sum(vl_investimento_previsto, na.rm = TRUE))

pins_tbl <- projects |>
  select(id_projeto_investimento, pins) |>
  unnest_longer(pins) |>
  filter(!map_lgl(pins, is.null)) |>
  mutate(wkt = map_chr(pins, ~ .x$pin %||% NA_character_)) |>
  filter(!is.na(wkt), wkt != "") |>
  select(-pins)

pins_by_project <- pins_tbl |>
  st_as_sf(wkt = "wkt", crs = 4674) |> 
  group_by(id_projeto_investimento) |>
  summarise(wkt = st_combine(wkt))

projects_st <- projects |> 
  select(-repassadores, -tomadores, -investimentos_previstos, -ppas, -eixos_tipos, -fotos, -pins, -areas_restricao, -executores) |> 
  left_join(taxonomy_tbl, by = "id_projeto_investimento") |> 
  left_join(pred_investment_tbl, by = "id_projeto_investimento") |> 
  left_join(pins_by_project |> 
              as_tibble(), by = "id_projeto_investimento") |> 
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "wkt", crs = 4674)

```

The Obrasgov API only allows for the extraction of point geometries. In order to enrich the dataset with multidimensional geometries we have to resort to another endpoint. Using Obrasgovr we first extract the geo-data metadata to identify which geometries are potentially multidimensional.

```{r geom_metadata}

geom_meta <- get_geometries(
  all_pages = T,
  page_size = 200
)

geom_meta_filtered <- geom_meta |> 
  filter(origem_geometria %in% c("Shapefile", "Vetorização"))
```

With the filtered IDs, we extract the full geometries.

```{r geometry_enrichment}
#| eval: false


library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(tibble)

ids <- unique(geom_meta_filtered$id_projeto_investimento)
target_geom_ids <- unique(geom_meta_filtered$id_geometria)

batches <- split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / 20))

get_geometries <- function(id) {
  request(
    "https://cipi.economia.gov.br/cipi-backend/api/public/projetoinvestimento/listar-geometrias-ids-projetos"
  ) |>
    req_body_raw(toJSON(id), "application/json") |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 5) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = FALSE) |>
    map_dfr(\(project)
            map_dfr(project$geometrias, \(geometry)
                    tibble(
                      id_projeto_investimento = project$idUnico,
                      id_geometria = geometry$id,
                      wkt = geometry$coordinates,
                      origem_coordenada = geometry$origemCoordenada,
                      srid = geometry$srid,
                      metadado = list(geometry$metadado),
                      justificativas = list(geometry$justificativas),
                      geometria_uf_municipio = list(geometry$geometriaUfMunicipio)
                    )
            )
    ) |>
    filter(id_geometria %in% target_geom_ids)
}

dir.create("geometry_batches", showWarnings = FALSE)

failed_ids <- character()

for (i in seq_along(batches)) {
  batch <- tibble(
    id_projeto_investimento = character(),
    id_geometria = integer(),
    wkt = character(),
    origem_coordenada = character(),
    srid = character(),
    metadado = list(),
    justificativas = list(),
    geometria_uf_municipio = list()
  )
  
  for (id in batches[[i]]) {
    result <- tryCatch(get_geometries(id), error = \(e) NULL)
    
    if (is.null(result)) {
      failed_ids <- c(failed_ids, id)
    } else {
      batch <- bind_rows(batch, result)
    }
  }
  
  saveRDS(batch, paste0("geometry_batches/batch_", i, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(failed_ids, "geometry_batches/failed_ids.rds")
}
```

```{r enriched_geom_import}

geometries_tbl <- list.files(
  "geometry_batches",
  pattern = "^batch_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  map_dfr(readRDS)


geometries_combined_st <- geometries_tbl |> 
  select(id_projeto_investimento:wkt) |> 
  st_as_sf(wkt = "wkt", crs = 4674) |> 
  group_by(id_projeto_investimento) |> 
  summarise(wkt = st_combine(wkt))
```

::: callout-note
- Metadata can be extracted for the individual geometries. For now, geometries were merged by project ID.
:::

We then join both tables and end up with the final data set for further manipulation.

```{r}
projects_st_final <- projects_st

i <- match(
  projects_st_final$id_projeto_investimento,
  geometries_combined_st$id_projeto_investimento
)

st_geometry(projects_st_final)[!is.na(i)] <-
  st_geometry(geometries_combined_st)[i[!is.na(i)]]

st_write(projects_st_final, "projects_st.gpkg")
```
